title: Mixed Duo #16
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women standing side by side, extraordinarily large women, far beyond any real person, a mix of pregnant and non-pregnant figures.

#1: Japanese, in her late 40s, cool and composed expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. An immense mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, sagging down toward her knees under its own weight, gathering into three or four heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other, deep shadowed creases between them, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum, not pregnant. A gigantic bust resting on the top fold, no waist at all, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, each thigh thicker than a normal woman's waist, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, luminous glossy skin with a bright highlighter, thick black eyeliner, extremely long dramatic false lashes top and bottom, large eyes with bright real catchlights, glossy peach-pink lips, towering teased bleached-blonde hair, a confident sparkling expression, sleek straight hair, real pores, real living eyes, 25 bars piercings set with amethysts in bronze-toned metal, wearing well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of rose-gold a hair ornament. Painted in Georgian minonkari cloisonné enamel, a deep black ground with fine gold cloisonné wirework, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide gold bands curving fully around every deep crease like contour lines, continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: standing with both arms raised overhead, elbows bent, torso fully visible, extreme gold extreme platform square-toe heels, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

#2: Korean, in her early 20s, cool and composed expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy on top of an already immense frame. An immense mass of soft heavy fat already sits on her middle in heavy rounded folds — and rising from the top of that mass, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects even further forward, its taut round surface distinct from the looser folds beneath it, no waist at all anywhere. A gigantic bust resting above the belly, colossal hips more than three times the width of her shoulders, thick heavy calves. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, glowing dewy skin, a precise winged liner, softly defined brown eyeshadow, full natural lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, sculpted contour with a satin highlight, plump glossy rose-coral lips, long sleek chestnut waves, a poised, refined, confident expression, sleek straight hair, real pores, real living eyes, 200 segment rings piercings set with sapphires in gold-toned metal, wearing well over ten pieces, an extreme maximalist stack of gold an anklet. Painted in Japanese Kutani porcelain, a cream-white ground with bold red, gold and green overglaze enamels, covering every inch of skin from neck to ankle without exception, wide gold-and-red bands curving fully around every deep crease like contour lines, the densest concentration wrapping the belly's rounded surface as the pattern's centrepiece and continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere left bare. Pose: kneeling on both knees facing the camera directly, both hands resting lightly atop the dome of her belly, serene direct eye contact, extreme gold-and-red extreme platform wedges, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Composition: each woman's own pose as described, inner arms not crossing her neighbours, generous spacing so every figure reads clearly. Lighting: a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle on any of them. Shot on a Hasselblad X2D, 3:4 aspect ratio, 8K.
